title: Calcium in Older Women
subtitle: How calcium in older women affects long-term health, function, and prevention.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports calcium’s role in bone health and fracture prevention in older women, especially when combined with vitamin D and lifestyle factors. Moderate evidence exists regarding optimal dosing and long-term safety. Emerging evidence raises questions about cardiovascular risks and non-skeletal effects, requiring further research.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
